scope: Host OFDM demodulator repair. No PAC, RF Auto, Windows DLL, USB format or raw IQ transformation. Offline diagnosis is separate from live acceptance.

implementation.dc: Continuous causal moving mean with carried sum/tail; finite settling after startup/reset.
implementation.cfo: Equivalent vectorized real sin/cos phasor; no payload fit.
implementation.receive_precision: Complex64 training/equalization and float32 pilot phase; original TX constants/files unchanged.
implementation.amplitude: Measured on original input before conditioning; optional raw file also unchanged.

diagnosis.bw0: 1375MHz TX65 historical raw: original0frames/1s; host selection recovers415frames, zero bit errors, EVM about13.5%. Around+700kHz out-of-occupied-band component impedes original periodic acquisition. Component source remains unknown. TX-off controls decode0frames.
diagnosis.bw1: 1900MHz raw: original/band-only526frames with307header failures; current band/DC833frames with0header failures in the same nominal1s TX-on window. Raw DC about[2.54,-2.54] native12 counts. Do not transfer BW0 spectral-cause claim to BW1.
diagnosis.unresolved: 1500MHz RX30: selection exposes about405preambles/1s, but all fail headers; DC rejection does not recover them. Do not increase levels solely for no-sync.
diagnosis.host_load: 65tap conditioning60s overflowed321650688bytes;33tap without vectorized CFO still overflowed61865984bytes. Vectorized10s also had an overflow; later timed10s had none. This shows host-load variability, not an established USB ceiling or universal performance guarantee. Do not hide failed runs or enlarge the queue as a cure.
diagnosis.profiler_limit: Live cProfile showed cross-thread caller attribution and cumulative times exceeding wall duration; use explicit per-method wall/thread CPU diagnostics, not that profile as exact stage CPU.

discovery.result: Unfiltered uhd_find_devices crashed0xc0000005 before TX; PnP still showed serialDEVICE_ID_REDACTED and targeted type=b200,serial=DEVICE_ID_REDACTED discovery succeeded. Runner now targets the requested identity. Not a device reconnect requirement.

overload_policy.setup: User: approximately50cm, existing dual-band Wi-Fi antennas, B210 physicalTRX1 / A:A A:B / channel0 / TX-RX.
overload_policy.rule: Record TX setting/source amplitude and preconditioning native12 peak/RMS/near rails. No digital rails does not exclude analog compression. Use lower-level single-variable comparisons where indicated; no automatic gain increase for no-sync.

source_file_accounting.scope: Acquisition relative to complete frames in the finite source file, including leading/trailing and host gaps. Not measured physical transmitted-frame count, RF start/end timing or precise sample loss.

iq_amplitude.scope: Every16th decoded host block, including startup/TX-off; near rail >=2040/2048. No digital clipping does not rule out analog compression.

demodulation.metric_scope: Independent per-subcarrier training; pilot-only phase tracking; PRBS selected by validated magic/sequence/complement. FER excludes missed headers; recent1000-frame EVM/CFO. Exact source loss unknown.

acceptance: Latest user criterion:10s wireless demonstration; new OFDM BW0/BW1 RX30 tests pass payload, host queue and lifecycle. Existing60s failures remain historical limits, not a pending mandatory gate.
limits: Older successful60s records prove their recorded implementation only.
Native12 amplitude sampling is stratified, not exhaustive saturation detection.
Valid-payload FER excludes missed headers; source-file yield is not measured actualRF transmitted-frame count.
Device/host byte agreement cannot prove no capture gaps; precise sample loss unknown.
Current communication work remains BW0/BW1 only.
